datasets.title: HDX HAPI Data for Ukraine
datasets.description: This dataset contains data obtained from the HDX Humanitarian API (HDX HAPI), which provides standardized humanitarian indicators designed for seamless interoperability from multiple sources. The data facilitates automated workflows and visualizations to support humanitarian decision making. For more information, please see the HDX HAPI landing page and documentation .. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/hdx-hapi-ukr]
datasets.details: HDX HAPI is refreshed daily, but the source datasets may have different update schedules. Please refer to the source datasets for each subcategory to verify their specific update frequency.

entity.name: Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project (ACLED)
OCHA Humanitarian Programme Cycle Tools (HPC Tools)

lineage.description: Aggregated humanitarian indicators from multiple UN agencies and data providers, standardized through HDX HAPI for interoperability. Data includes displacement tracking, humanitarian needs assessments, and contextual indicators compiled at administrative levels for Ukraine.

sources.name: Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project (ACLED)

sources.name: INFORM
sources.description: Provides national risk index scores combining hazard, vulnerability, and coping capacity indicators

sources.name: International Organization for Migration (IOM)
sources.description: Provides displacement tracking data including IDP counts and population movement assessments

sources.name: OCHA Humanitarian Programme Cycle Tools (HPC Tools)
sources.description: Provides humanitarian needs overview data including people in need figures by sector

sources.name: UNHCR - The UN Refugee Agency
sources.description: Provides refugee and returnee population statistics disaggregated by demographics

sources.name: WFP - World Food Programme
sources.description: Provides food price and market monitoring data for food security assessment
